description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named HelloSpellCheckerActivity, which demonstrates the use of Android's text services API to perform spell checking and sentence suggestions within an app. It implements SpellCheckerSessionListener to handle callback responses for suggestions.

classes.name: HelloSpellCheckerActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling spell checking via Android's TextServicesManager and displaying suggestions in a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and retrieves the main TextView.

methods.name: isSentenceSpellCheckSupported
methods.description: Checks if the device's SDK version supports sentence-level spell checking.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up the spell checker session and requests suggestions based on the platform's capabilities.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes the spell checker session to release resources.

methods.name: dumpSuggestionsInfoInternal
methods.description: Formats and appends suggestions information into a StringBuilder for display.

methods.name: onGetSuggestions
methods.description: Callback method invoked with suggestions for individual text inputs.

methods.name: onGetSentenceSuggestions
methods.description: Callback method invoked with sentence-level suggestions.
